subject: RM_Muttavaq
departures: back is a low mounded field of regular polygon plates, like a cracked clay pan, not hide or a single shell
cracks between the plates radiate out from one central point on the back, more regular than natural dried clay
mouth is lined with jaw-plates for straining mud, not tusks or teeth
body is so broad, low and flat-topped that it could pass for a patch of ground, with no distinct neck or raised head silhouette
skin and back are the colour and texture of dried canyon clay, so the animal looks like part of the terrain
